cases.name: pull-minimal
cases.covers: Smallest legal pull: PULL_HEADER refers to the list by digest, with a replica cursor and an echo digest; no UNIT frame (§4.1, §4.2)

cases.name: pull-bootstrap
cases.covers: A traveling list of two units + two PROGRESS frames: a fresh bootstrap (cursor = -1) and a resumed bootstrap (cursor at the §4.7 pin, bootstrapState round-trip); accept bits incl. sqlite + signed URLs; empty echoDigest

cases.name: push-multi-commit
cases.covers: outboxId + two commits with increasing clientSeq: upsert with baseVersion, delete, sparse-row payload edge cases (presence and NULL bitmaps, empty string, non-BMP unicode, json-typed column raw-string round-trip)

cases.name: combined
cases.covers: Push + pull in one envelope (§1.5 ordering): a referenced list with one post-bootstrap unit in PROGRESS

cases.name: epoch-bound
cases.covers: Request header with the stored partition logEpoch (§2.1) and outboxId (§6.3.2)

cases.name: json-boundaries
cases.covers: JSON validity rule (Conventions) at its accepting edge: one PROGRESS.bootstrapState nested exactly 64 containers deep, a second with whitespace, a duplicate key, the largest finite binary64 and escapes

cases.name: round-failure-report
cases.covers: ROUND_FAILURE (§1.5) immediately after REQ_HEADER: the client reports the code of its last round that failed where the server could not see it

cases.name: empty-registration
cases.covers: A pull whose registrationDigest is the empty list's digest and which carries no UNIT frame: the empty list travels (§4.1)

cases.name: producer-push
cases.covers: A database-less producer push: no outboxId, clientSeq = 0 (§6.10)

invalid.name: truncated-no-end
invalid.covers: Truncated envelope: body ends without an END frame

invalid.name: bad-magic
invalid.covers: Envelope magic is SSP1, not SSP2

invalid.name: wire-version-3
invalid.covers: wireVersion 3 is rejected as unknown before reading frames (§9)

invalid.name: nonzero-flags
invalid.covers: Envelope flags byte must be 0x00

invalid.name: overlong-frame-length
invalid.covers: Frame length prefix exceeds the remaining bytes

invalid.name: op-enum-out-of-range
invalid.covers: Push operation op byte 3 (unknown enum byte)

invalid.name: upsert-without-payload
invalid.covers: Upsert operation with absent payload (presence invariant)

invalid.name: round-failure-duplicate
invalid.covers: Two ROUND_FAILURE frames (§1.5: at most one)

invalid.name: round-failure-after-push
invalid.covers: ROUND_FAILURE after a PUSH_COMMIT (§1.5: only directly after REQ_HEADER)

invalid.name: round-failure-bad-code
invalid.covers: ROUND_FAILURE code outside the §1.5 grammar (hyphen instead of a dotted segment)

invalid.name: bootstrap-state-json-number-overflow
invalid.covers: PROGRESS.bootstrapState holds 1e999, outside finite binary64 (Conventions JSON validity rule)

invalid.name: bootstrap-state-json-depth-65
invalid.covers: PROGRESS.bootstrapState nests 65 containers (Conventions JSON validity rule)

invalid.name: registration-digest-31-bytes
invalid.covers: PULL_HEADER.registrationDigest of 31 bytes (§4.2: exactly 32)

invalid.name: echo-digest-16-bytes
invalid.covers: PULL_HEADER.echoDigest of 16 bytes (§4.2: 0 or 32)

invalid.name: pull-cursor-below-minus-one
invalid.covers: PULL_HEADER.cursor = -2 (§4.2: -1 or above)

invalid.name: progress-id-uppercase
invalid.covers: PROGRESS.id in uppercase hex (§4.3: 32 lowercase hex characters)

invalid.name: unit-after-progress
invalid.covers: UNIT after a PROGRESS frame (§1.5: PROGRESS follows every UNIT)

invalid.name: unit-without-pull-header
invalid.covers: UNIT without a PULL_HEADER (§1.5)

invalid.name: outbox-id-empty
invalid.covers: REQ_HEADER.outboxId present but empty (§1.5)

invalid.name: client-seq-negative
invalid.covers: PUSH_COMMIT.clientSeq = -1 (§6.1: non-negative)
